description.value:
You become trained in Society and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Mantarider]{Management Material} skill feat. You can use [[/act make-an-impression skill=deception]], [[/act make-an-impression skill=diplomacy]], or [[/act make-an-impression skill=intimidation]] instead of Society to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Make an Impression] or Impersonate a professional using Management Material. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Aid] an ally using Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation instead of any other skill, depending on what style of management you think will help encourage them.

Special You can take this feat even if you already have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.AbadarCorp Rep Dedication] feat and haven't taken two additional AbadarCorp rep archetype feats. Franchise manager archetype feats count as AbadarCorp rep archetype feats, and vice versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

value.value: trained in Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation
